name: Problem 301 Redirect
author: Pranshtech Solutions Private Limited

sections.description:
The Problem 301 Redirect plugin automatically applies 301 redirect rules to URLs in WordPress, helping maintain SEO rankings and prevent broken links.
It provides a simple way to manage redirects across your site without any technical configuration.

The WordPress plugin Problem 301 Redirect enables users to create and manage 301 redirects through a simple interface, which helps users resolve broken links and maintain their search engine rankings, and achieve seamless website transitions.

The plugin enables users to perform URL redirection without requiring .htaccess editing or coding knowledge or complex setup procedures.

The plugin interface allows users to create individual redirects or import multiple redirects from CSV files. The Existing Redirects page enables users to access complete redirect management through view & edit, and delete functions.

The plugin operates as a lightweight tool that provides basic functionality to solve redirection issues without adding extra features

Perfect For
Users need to fix broken links that appear on their website.

The process of website redesign requires URL changes.

Users need to rename or restructure their website content through page and post URL changes.

The plugin helps users maintain their SEO rankings during domain migrations.

The plugin serves SEO professionals who need quick redirect management tools.

WordPress administrators who want to set up redirects without writing code will find this plugin useful.

CSV Format Example (for Bulk Import)
Prepare your CSV file in this structure:
old_url new_url
/old-page /new-page
/blog/post-1 /articles/post-1
/color/red /red-color

The file may include a header row. Only two columns are required: old_url and new_url.

How to Use
Users can access Problem 301 Redirect through their WordPress Dashboard.

Users can create new redirects by selecting the Add New Redirect option from the dashboard.

Users can import multiple redirects at once through the Bulk Import via CSV function by uploading their CSV file and clicking Import Redirects.

Users can access the Existing Redirects tab to view and manage their previously created redirects.

The plugin activates redirects immediately after installation without requiring any additional configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Install Problem 301 Redirect either via the WordPress.org plugin directory or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. You will see the Problem 301 Redirect option in your WordPress admin area (under the Plugins section). Click on it.
  4. Configure your redirect settings as needed.
  5. That’s it! It’s really that simple!
sections.faq:
How do I create a new redirect?

Go to Problem 301 Redirect in your WordPress admin, click “Add New Redirect,” enter the old URL and new URL, then save.

Can I import multiple redirects at once?

Yes, use the “Bulk Import via CSV” function to upload a CSV file with your redirects.

How do I manage existing redirects?

Go to the “Existing Redirects” tab to view, edit, or delete all previously created redirects.

Do I need technical knowledge to use this plugin?

No, the plugin operates automatically without requiring .htaccess modifications or coding skills.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and performance-optimized to avoid conflicts with other themes or plugins.
